GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.3 (25 Feb 46) CCS
(SCAPIN - 773)
APO 500
25 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Provisions of Japanese Long Distance Telephone Service Foe Occupational Force Use.
1． It is directed that the Japanese Board of Communications arrange to furnish long distance telephone service to Occupation Forces from Japanese long distance telephone control offices and that all service thus furnished be handled as special urgent.
2． Long distance calls will be filed from and routed to designated swichboards and lines serving occupation headquarters at various points throughout Japan and these calls will be in addition to other service already being furnished.
3． Details necessary to establish the long distance service directed above, including designation of point between which service is desired, will be arranged between the Civil Communications Section of this Headquarters and the Board of Communications. Direct correspondence between these agencies within the scope of this memorandum is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
